scripts.setup: npm install && npm run build:shared && npm run setup --workspace=ai-engine
scripts.start: npm run build:shared && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names "api,ai,kiosk,admin,online" --prefix-colors "blue,magenta,cyan,yellow,green" "npm run start --workspace=api-server" "npm run start --workspace=ai-engine" "npm run start --workspace=kiosk-app" "npm run start --workspace=admin-portal" "npm run start --workspace=online-portal"
scripts.start:backend: npm run build:shared && concurrently --names "api,ai" --prefix-colors "blue,magenta" "npm run start --workspace=api-server" "npm run start --workspace=ai-engine"
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=api-server && npm run test --workspace=ai-engine
